method: Three passes as requested. Each pass builds on the previous one; findings below are real defects/gaps found and fixed, not a rubber stamp.

pass_1_implement_and_verify.scope: Review repo + nine focus sites' evidence, answer why 0.2778 (OWNER) won, pre-register 4 ranked hypotheses, validate top two on the hide-and-recover holdout vs the same-run best control, build a unique TIF with validator + lane checks, register it with obvious download/submit labels, rebuild site/README.
done: Restored 22 SHA-256-pinned inputs (core/external/scored) via scripts/restore_data.py; rebuilt the cached feature stack; hashes bit-identical to evidence/work_cache_hashes.json (comparator environment verified, IR-25-COMPARATOR-DRIFT does not apply to these runs).
Pre-registered knowledge/21 (4 ranked hypotheses) and committed it BEFORE any fit (d40ae7d); three pre-fit operator amendments committed separately with data-property evidence only (no outcome seen).

Implemented src/gems25/h36.py (spectral tilt-zero coincidence) and h37.py (seismicity structure-tensor alignment) with synthetic unit tests; runners reuse gems25.experiment.Cell, gems25.metric.dti_binary, gems25.submission writer/checker (no private forks).
Experiment 1 H36-TZC screen (draws 30-31): paired -0.0013, 2/4 folds, canary 0.588 -> NEGATIVE, no confirmation.
Pre-registered knowledge/22 BEFORE Experiment 2; H37-SEISALIGN screen (draws 40-41): paired -0.0021, 1/4 folds, canary 0.536 -> NEGATIVE, no confirmation.

Built unique TIF gems25-h36-tiltzero-coincide-sapd2-4-k3p5-20261025-92562b7b7fea-zeros.tif (48,634 dots, SHA-256 8bbddbb4...) + NaN twin + ZIP; check_file hard checks all pass; surface lane Spearman 0.151; final-dot lane duplicate/stop recorded (lattice 100%, H35 92.2%).
Registered as primary download with verdict negative, ok_to_download=true, ok_to_submit_slot=false; rebuilt README + site; run card registry/run_card_h36_h37_2026-10-25.json; outcomes knowledge/23.

found_and_fixed: Provider derivative bands are scale-mismatched for a direct tilt (tmi_hg per-km magnitude vs tmi_vg ~300x smaller): tilt recomputed spectrally from the field bands (Amendment 1, IR-25-H36-DERIVATIVE-BAND-SCALES).
Tolerance-gated zero mask missed sharp contacts (synthetic step jumps -0.268 -> +0.268 rad with no |theta|<=0.05 pixel): zero line redefined as sign-change adjacency (Amendment 2).
Ungated magnetic zero set covered 23.4% of the footprint (sign speckle in gradient-free areas): crossings gated to at/above-median THDR (Amendment 3). All amendments precede every holdout fit.

First candidate build was restarted before completion because its embedded note (139 chars, missing 'no slot') would have failed the site note tests (<=120, required phrases); the shipped note is 105 chars and test-enforced.

tests/test_kdc.py was bound to role='primary' and failed once KDC became an alternate: retargeted to the KDC entry by id; added tests/test_h36_submission.py guarding the new primary's labels, hashes, lane stop and negative gates (151 tests pass).
README latest-session line did not update on the first rebuild (edit/run race): rebuilt and verified in the rendered README and site HTML.
Registration summary initially described the lane fail as lattice-only; corrected to name the substantive own-lineage H35/H31 overlap (92.2%) before registering.
known_residual_risks: Holdout is a catalogue-gap proxy (proxy-vs-live Spearman +0.33, n=24, n.s.); both negatives are 'no demonstrated gain', with paired CIs including small positive values.

The shipped TIF's detector shares the BDE+tip+H34 base with H35/H31-C, so its dots are a lane duplicate by placement even though its content bytes are unique; it must never be submitted as a distinct lane.
GEMSDOE32's newer unscored lanes (Arena41, H32-WIN) are not in this repo's pinned registry (IR-25-GEMSDOE32-NEW-LANES-UNCHECKED), so lane checks cannot include them.
All competition rasters are owner mirrors, not organizer-authenticated (IR-25-PROVENANCE); 0.2778/0.3195/0.4413 remain OWNER claims (leaderboard conflict unresolved).
